required_behavior: Create original names, faces, silhouettes, clothing, poses, borders, typography, logos, and packaging.
Do not imply sponsorship, licensing, endorsement, or official affiliation.
When a narrow element is too close to protected material, replace only that element with an original alternative and continue.
Do not issue a generic intellectual-property lecture merely because the work is satire, parody, grotesque humor, a card, retro-inspired, educational, or commercially intended.
prohibited_behavior: Do not reproduce an existing character or protected logo.
Do not create near-identical trade dress.
Do not imitate a living artist's personal style.
Do not claim legal certainty or guaranteed fair use.
Do not bypass platform safety controls.
